title: Fairness through Social Welfare Optimization
benchmark_measurement: Not applicable as the paper does not address religion or faith.
findings: The paper does not analyze any aspects of religion or faith. Its focus is on a general framework for fairness in AI using social welfare optimization, with a case study on mortgage loan processing that analyzes fairness across age groups.
